acquisition.reuse: January 2 complete quote/trade pilot and saved complete sparse trade tapes

performance_policy: No experiment before admissible family/subset and separately frozen exact dataset/assumptions. No automatic special exemption to report a zero-return no-trade control.

proposed_tiers.1: bounded conditional performance only with scoped identity/action/status/execution evidence and frozen final-export delay/revision sensitivity; not actual-arrival reconstruction
proposed_tiers.2: higher fidelity source-availability, native size, quote/trade/status and execution calibration evidence
proposed_tiers.3: production calibration requires independent live certification and broader operational qualifications; cannot grant orders

selection: same three symbols from preexisting execution pilot; first five development sessions by calendar; no outcome selection
tier1_nonnegotiable: verified exact source bytes and chronology
scoped stable security identity; CIK or current ticker alone insufficient
corporate action basis for every lookback/exposure interval
positive status evidence for decisions/exposure; no archive-absence inference
complete scoped quote/trade evidence and native size semantics
explicit availability assumptions distinct from actual receipts
causal matching on chosen availability clock; no future quote
unchanged strategy definitions and bounded parameters
risk and simulator safety gates; no brokerage authority
timing_rationale: Exact application arrival is not necessary for a explicitly hypothetical development sensitivity experiment, but final-export data alone cannot establish that the hypothetical path happened. Timing relaxation does not waive identity/status/fill evidence.
unchanged_requests: rerun original 16 requests without altering symbols, windows or definitions; retain old decisions separately from new scoped tier review
